notes.title: Update notes for build #5305
notes.notes:
Changes in this new version:
[list]
[*]Better compatibility with GTA V mod FiveM

[/list]

notes.title: New update #5271
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

This new version has support for new Nvidia video cards 30xx (for system information overlay). We also fixed bugs with injecting into UWP games and vulkan-powered games.
Web browser overlay was also updated to the latest Chromium engine version (this added several megabytes of size).

notes.title: New update 5090
notes.notes:
Hello!
Here is new version with updated Teamspeak 3 plugin (API 23) required for new TS3 client version.
Also minor improvements in OpenGL games compatibility are available.
While our plugins are not approved in myteamspeak portal, here is how to set them manually https://playclaw.com/support/scenes-overlays/overlays/teamspeak3/

notes.title: Nice minor update
notes.notes:
Here is our new release #5075.

Changes list:
⚡ Better compatibility with DX10/11/12 games on some systems.
⚡ Desktop widget now has an Update Rate option like overlays. Previous versions updated it 10 times per second by default.
⚡ Fixed crash in an overlay effects settings in some conditions
⚡ We've added boolean sensors (1/0 or Yes/No, On/Off). For example, CPU core sensors "Critical Temperature" and "Thermal Throttling" and others.
⚡ Fixed bug selecting software interface font in the program options. Our Asian comrades have noted this and we have fixed this ;) Translations will be updated too in next release.

notes.title: Improvements in the new version
notes.notes:
Hello boys and girls! Here is new release #5070.
[list]
[*] Desktop widget now has less options for background configuring and, at the same time, it is more powerful
[*] Added simple macros in Sysinfo overlay (and Text overlays) (manual is coming soon)
[*] Added back color setting in Sysinfo bar overlay
[*] Fixed bug not saving custom CSS in Browser overlay when CSS text size is too big
[*] Added wildcard in the blacklist
[*] Added ability to set pre-recording file buffer location
[*] Fixed compatibility with Sandboxie-powered processes
[*] Fixed Teamspeak 3 overlay bug not rendering events after client restart and wrong events recognition ([b][u]you must to update teamspeak 3 plugin for this new version![/u][/b])
[/list]

notes.title: Maintenance release #5020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This new update will give you new features in Sysinfo charts overlay and several fixes.

[h1]Changes list[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sysinfo overlay additions: added alerts, fill charts option (instead of drawing only lines), lines anti-aliasing option
[*]Fixed compatibility with some latest Vulkan-powered games: Strange Brigade, Quake 2 VK
[*]Forza Horizon 4 is now in black list and you can run it with the program without crash, we hope :)
[*]Fixed bug rendering overlay properties window
[*]Added ability to get AMD GPU sensors values from drivers instead of low level access
[*]Fixed bug not auto-scaling overlays if the program is started in minimized mode
[/list]

If you like to use some "non-standard" codecs like MagicYUV or Lagarith, then we have a good news for you.
We've found a 3rd party plugin developed for PlayClaw 6 https://github.com/ignus2/playclaw6-plugin-encoder-vfw which can use built-in Video for Windows codecs.

notes.title: New release and Sysinfo overlay tutorial
notes.notes:
A new version #4820 is ready to download.
[list]
[*]Fixed crash during second pre-recording buffer flush when MJPEG codec is used
[*]Fixed bug not starting translation because of empty translation key (but key is good)
[*]Fixed compatibility with Ring of Elysium
[*]Reduced CPU usage of hardware sensors measurement module
[*]Fixed bug full processing of processes that do not contain graphics modules DirectX,OpenGL,...
[*]Added new options in Sysinfo graph overlay
[*]Fixed wrong AMD CPUs temperatures in Sysinfo
[*]Fixed bug not saving of some Sysinfo graph and bars settings
[*]Better statistics calculation for 0.1/1% Low sensor
[*]Temporary added console output in statistics overlay, firstly, for error messages
[*]Added ability to show hours in statistics overlay if recording or streaming duration is more than 60 minutes
[*]Added lines separators and dummy sensors in Sysinfo overlay for better formatting
[/list]

Check out this tutorial how to set up System information overlay in PlayClaw:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rq9Qn-iYDpM

notes.title: Color filter feature in new version
notes.notes:
This release #4450 has one new feature and several fixes:
[list]
[*]Added Color filter feature (overlays properties)
[*]Fixed detection of some DirectX 9 games (like Heroes & Generals)
[*]Fixed memory leak when using AMD H.264 encoder
[*]Fixed some interface bugs in Windows 7

[/list]

notes.title: Output effects feature in this new release!
notes.notes:
New build #4400 is ready to download with new feature - output overlays effects.
Effects will change overlay image on output (local file or streaming), not ingame. These effects are done completely on GPU and do not affect your CPU load.

Short video preview with main changes: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hv0zJgL1CMs
[list]
[*]Added overlay output effects: [u]Chroma key[/u], [u]Scrolling[/u]
[*]Added [u]Sysinfo Bar[/u] overlay
[*]Added FPS Lock feature
[*]Added ability to change overlays names (use F2 in overlays list)
[*]Added basic interface layout settings
[*]Fixed NVEnc H.264 failure on some resolutions (1440x900, 1366x768)
[*]Better NVEnc H.264 detection
[*]Fixed bug loading images with alpha channel
[*]Fixed bug getting AMD Ryzen 1500X temperature
[*]Fixed bug starting with AMD Ramdisk running
[/list]

[u]This build changes how overlays can be resized.[/u] If you use a mouse for resize, then original source overlay size will be changed. If you use CTRL button with mouse, then overlay will be scaled.

[i]Do you need overlays effects ingame?[/i] Sorry, it is not possible now. We will come back to this question later, after new year.

notes.title: PlayClaw 6 release!
notes.notes:
We're glad to say that version 6 is ready enough to be released ;)
Of course, we plan to add a lot more features which you and we like to see. We're working with this and constantly improving our software.

Version 6 has completely different interface in comparison with version 5. Overlays rule! Other things are just addons. Important addons ;)

Is it better than version 5? Of course! It is faster, it is more reliable, it is more flexible.

We hope you will enjoy seeing our overlays and recording and streaming your game play with PlayClaw 6 ;)
